To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) A stochastic scene grammar provides a unified representation for visual entities and abstract knowledge; (2) A scene understanding system can be built by reasoning about functionality, physical mechanisms and human action.

we develop stochastic grammar model to represent visual structures, augment the grammar with commonsense knowledge and perform inference for scene understanding, and acquire commonsense knowledge by observing human actions, learning by one shot demonstration, and reasoning about physical stability.

(i) we can build a unified framework for scene understanding by functional and physical reasoning; (ii) we can build an intelligent system that can understand the scene by acquiring commonsense knowledg from observing human actions or single one shot demonstrations; (iii) we can build intelligent systems that can interact with the 2D and 3D world by inferring the physical stability of objects and scenes.
